why: A campaign that details a place before its whole has been walked. The whole map is judged first, in game, and the record of that judgement is what unlocks the parts — because detailing is where a map's cost stops being cheap to change, and an ordering that exists only as prose inverts the moment the second half is easier to start. What the engine can check is freshness and an explicit verdict; that a human really walked is the record author's assertion, and nothing here pretends otherwise. It declares no unit: every field of `detail-plan` is written in the site-plan overlay and compiles there, so there is nothing to exempt — what must not compile is a binding with no walk behind it.
